+ and –, 7 and 3
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

In this question interchanging the given two signs and numbers in the given options equations.

**Given: **+ and –, 7 and 3

Let's check each option one by one:

**Option 1) **7 + 3 × 9 – 8 ÷ 2 = 30

After interchanging the numbers and sign we get the:

⇒ 3 - 7 × 9 + __**8 ÷ 2**__ = 30

⇒ 3 - __**7 × 9**__ + 4 = 30

⇒ **3** - 63 + **4** = 30

⇒ 7 - 63 = 40

⇒ - 56 ≠ 40

⇒ **LHS ≠ RHS**

**Option 2) **9 × 7 + 3 – 4 ÷ 2 = 18 

After interchanging the numbers and sign we get the:

⇒ 9 × 3 - 7 + __**4 ÷ 2 **__= 18 

⇒ __**9 × 3**__ - 7 + 2 = 18

⇒ __**27**__ - 7 __**+ 2 **__= 18

⇒__** 29 - 7**__ = 18

⇒ 22 ≠ 18

⇒ **LHS ≠ RHS**

**Option 3) **3 × 4 ÷ 2 + 7 – 5 = 16 

After interchanging the numbers and sign we get the:

⇒ 7 × __**4 ÷ 2**__ - 3 + 5 = 16 

⇒ __**7 × 2**__ - 3 + 5 = 16

⇒ __**14**__ - 3 __**+ 5**__ = 16

⇒ __**19 - 3**__ = 16

⇒ 16 = 16

⇒ **LHS = RHS**

**Option 4) **3 + 7 ÷ 1 – 4 × 2 = 16 

After interchanging the numbers and sign we get the:

⇒ 7 - __**3 ÷ 1**__ + 4 × 2 = 16 

⇒ 7 - 3 + __**4 × 2**__ = 16

⇒ __**7**__ - 3 __**+ 8**__ = 16

⇒ 15 - 3 = 16

⇒ 12 ≠ 16

⇒ **LHS ≠ RHS**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

questions.question: How many fundamental duties are provided in the Indian Constitution?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**11**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original constitution contained only the fundamental rights and not the fundamental duties.
 
• They incorporated the duties of the State in the Constitution in the form of Directive Principles of State Polity.
 
• In 1976 Sardar Swarna Singh committee to make recommendations about fundamental duties
 
• The 42nd Constitution amendment act in 1976 added a new part IVA 
 
• It consists of only one article that is article 51A
 
• Swarna Singh suggested 8 fundamental duties in the constitution, 42nd Constitution amendment act added 10 duties
 
• In 2002, one more Fundamental Duty was added.
 
• So, at present there are total of 11 Fundamental Duties are included in the Indian Constitution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Fundamental Duties in the Indian Constitution are inspired by the Constitution of the erstwhile USSR.
 
• None of the Constitutions of major democratic countries like the USA, Canada, France, Germany, Australia, and so on specifically contain a list of duties of citizens.
 
• Japanese Constitution is, perhaps, the only democratic Constitution in the world that contains a list of duties of citizens.
 
• Fundamental duties are confined to citizens only and do not extend to foreigners.
 
• Fundamental duties are non-justiceable.

• The simple present tense in the passive voice has the following structure: __Object+ is/am/are+ V3+ by + subject__
 
• Example - 
 
 
• Active voice - *They grow plants.*
 
• Passive voice - *Plants are grown by them.*
 
 
 
• Rules of Conversion from Active to Passive Voice:
 
 
• Identify the subject, the verb, and the object.
 
• Change the subject into an object.
 
• Change the verb into the past participle form.
 
• Change the object into the subject.
